item.title: Pop Warner Steelers Finish 8th In The Nation
item.description: It was halftime at the 2025 Pop Warner Super Bowl in Charlotte, N.C. The scrappy band of 25 New Haven Steelers were down a mere six points to the reigning national champs. To hear Coach Garrett Barros tell it, there was belief in the locker room. “We told the kids, ‘we’re still in this.'" The post Pop Warner Steelers Finish 8th In The Nation appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: Long Wharf Drive’s Partial Closure Approved
item.description: The Elicker administration won permission this week to close a portion of Long Wharf Drive's roadway as it moves forward with plans to build out a waterfront park complete with a new basketball court, pickleball courts, an "urban beach," a promenade, a playground, a reconfigured food truck area, and lots more parking.
